cand.excerpt: Medium-high: exact dates, corporate audience and shared lunch; fixed venue lowers accessibility.

verifyPrev.futureEditionText: Officially announced upcoming session within the requested horizon: Tuesday 23 February, Wednesday 24 February and Tuesday 23 March 2027; each day 09:00–12:30 and 13:30–17:00. These are teaching dates, not publication dates. The first-to-last date span is not a continuous residential programme. No later edition through June 2028 was found officially announced.
verifyPrev.venueText: SPARK is the officially published 2027 venue. This is not a hotel lodging commitment; hotel sourcing remains unconfirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Frank Sobczak is verified as FER Genève Director of Training and is the named contact on the organizer’s continuing-training page. He is a commercially relevant organizer-side routing contact for this course, but his personal assignment to the 2027 session and hotel contracting authority are not published. Sylvain Grisard is explicitly named on the exact 2027 edition as trainer, with the role Responsable Distribution, G&F Châtelain, succursale de Chanel Sàrl. He is an edition-specific programme contact, not a verified accommodation buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Official teaching dates: 23 February, 24 February and 23 March 2027, each 09:00–12:30 and 13:30–17:00. The first-to-last span is not a continuous residential stay.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: Centre de formation FER Genève – SPARK, Chemin du Champ-des-Filles 4B, 1228 Plan-les-Ouates, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. This establishes the advertised teaching venue, not a hotel contract.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing unconfirmed. The edition page gives a training-service enquiry channel, cours.seminaires@fer-ge.ch, 058 715 33 15; it does not publish accommodation arrangements, room blocks or a hotel buyer.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Frank Sobczak at frank.sobczak@fer-ge.ch, referencing the three exact teaching dates and SPARK venue; copy cours.seminaires@fer-ge.ch. Ask who coordinates this session and whether any trainer or participant accommodation is organizer-managed. Do not pitch relocation of the committed teaching venue or quote an assumed room block. Only pursue YOTEL Geneva Lake lodging if non-local demand and suitability of Founex are confirmed.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: A named organizer-side approach is available through Frank Sobczak and the session’s training-service channel. No evidence establishes an accessible lodging tender or hotel allocation.
